# cc-skill-usage

> Single-file Python CLI that reads Claude Code's own JSONL transcripts under
> `~/.claude/projects/` and reports Skill invocation counts, timing, project
> breakdown, and triggering context. Retroactive: works over history already
> on disk, no hook or daemon to install ahead of time.

Counts a Skill as invoked only when the model calls the `Skill` tool: a
`tool_use` block with `name == "Skill"` and the skill name in `input.skill`
(sometimes namespaced, e.g. `cowork:update-releases`). A skill merely named
in a reply, a file, or typed in passing by a human is never counted. This
distinction was verified against real data: one skill in a real transcript
set showed 2330 raw text mentions of its name against 11 confirmed
invocations, a 212x gap, cross-checked independently via a from-scratch
`grep`+`jq` pipeline matching exactly.

Requires Python 3.8+, standard library only, no dependencies. Install with
`curl` to `~/.local/bin/cc-skill-usage`, or run `./cc-skill-usage` directly
from a clone.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): full usage reference, every flag, the invocation
  signature, the caching model, and known limitations (worktree project
  matching, an OOM guard on tool-result parsing and its context tradeoff,
  slash-command invocations, self-referential scan noise).
- [EXAMPLES](EXAMPLES.md): concrete goals mapped to the exact flag
  combination that answers them (monthly recap, one repo versus everything
  else, scripting with `--json`, cross-checking a count that looks wrong).
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md): every fix and feature with the concrete bug it
  addressed and how it was verified, in chronological order.
- [prompts/scenario-tour.md](prompts/scenario-tour.md): paste-into-a-session
  prompt that runs every documented scenario against real data and reports
  drift between the docs and the tool.
- [prompts/deep-dive-report.md](prompts/deep-dive-report.md): paste-into-a-
  session prompt for a multi-agent report crossing usage data with the
  `eval-skills` quality audit.
- [.claude/skills/skill-usage-report/SKILL.md](.claude/skills/skill-usage-report/SKILL.md):
  a bundled Claude Code Skill that drives the CLI and interprets its output,
  including the mandatory cross-verification step when a count looks off.
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): MIT.

## Key facts for accurate answers about this tool

- Entry point: the `cc-skill-usage` file itself, a single script, no package.
- Data source: `~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl` (override via `CC_PROJECTS_DIR`).
- Cache: `~/.cache/cc-skill-usage/index.json` (override via
  `CC_SKILL_USAGE_CACHE`), keyed by file mtime, schema-versioned so a format
  change invalidates old cache entries instead of crashing on them.
- `--project NAME` matches both the session's cwd basename and the encoded
  project directory, so one needle catches every git worktree of a repo, not
  only the main one.
- `--show-context` shows the last `role: user` text message preceding an
  invocation. Records over 20KB or containing a `tool_result` block are
  skipped before parsing to avoid re-parsing large tool output (file reads,
  command output) that is also stored as `role: user` but never carries a
  Skill invocation.
- No telemetry, no network access, no write access outside its own cache
  directory.
